images.name: Chief Power
images.description: Chief Power is an ArcLight Energy Partners Fund V-backed merchant-generation platform holding partial tenant-in-common interests in the Keystone and Conemaugh coal-fired generating stations in western Pennsylvania. ArcLight established the platform in 2014 and expanded it through a separately financed acquisition in 2019. After a 2020 lender restructuring transferred control of the original tranche, Fund V retained a small minority voting interest and continued to control the separately owned Chief Power Finance II tranche. Current public filings identify Fund V as holding greater than 10% voting interests in each II plant-owner entity, while the exact Fund V economic percentage is not publicly disclosed. Chief Power is the single PortCo; its financing entities, transfer parent, plant-owner subsidiaries and the two jointly owned generating stations are not separate portfolio companies.

milestones.event: ArcLight Energy Partners Fund V completed the acquisition of Exelon's 41.98% Keystone and 31.28% Conemaugh ownership interests and established the Chief Power platform.
Chief Power acquired additional minority interests, increasing its original tranche to 44.45% of Keystone and 35.11% of Conemaugh.
ArcLight's separately financed Chief II entities completed the acquisition of PSEG's 22.84% Keystone and 22.5% Conemaugh interests.

A lender restructuring transferred control of the original Chief Power Finance tranche to Chief Power Transfer Parent; Fund V retained a small interest subsequently reported at approximately 3%, while the separate Chief Power Finance II tranche remained outside the transfer and under ArcLight control.
